title: Beta watchlist
gradeCaps: A zero on the cash-runway test caps the grade at C.
One customer over 40% of sales caps the grade at C.
A controlling holder caps the grade at B, unless the company already turns a free-cash-flow profit.
eject: Cash runway under 18 months, with no committed financing.
Restated financials, or a fraud or SEC enforcement finding.
Beneish M above −1.78 on two straight reports.
Revenue falling for two straight quarters versus a year earlier.
Grade D for two straight quarters.
changelog: Oct 19, 2026: backlog is now compared with yearly revenue, not with the company's market value.
Oct 19, 2026: the cash-runway test scores at least 1 when net cash covers three years of burn or more.
